result.summary: CHANGELOG.md entry added for ISS-0132 (GH #427): this repo now has std.testing.checkAllAllocationFailures coverage for the first time, ending a leak signature that recurred across 18 pipeline runs. Documented the split between what GH #428 (55f7768) had already landed (parseTimerConfig, cloneJsonValueSafe/cloneObjectMapSafe) and the real remaining gap (parseGraphJson in src/definition/store.zig, which had zero test blocks and was reachable from no addTest root); the corrected alloc-site counts (transition.zig 110 sites / 15 errdefer, not the issue's 51/12; store.zig 35 / 8 / 0 test blocks); the proof the new tests fail on unfixed code (TC-04 fail_index 6/25 at store.zig:1344, TC-05 fail_index 9/11 at store.zig:1366, 2 leaks, against a byte-identical parseGraphJson per git diff --stat 63 insertions / 0 deletions); the three leaks fixed (PGJ-1 latent double-free, PGJ-2/PGJ-3 partial-struct-construction); the lint_test_wiring [UNATTACHED] near-miss on criterion 4; verification numbers (83/83 steps, 939/1003, zero leak lines, +3 delta vs main baseline 81/81, 936/1000); and the forwarded ISS-0206 / GH #526 as out of REACH rather than out of scope. Requirement mapping was checked, not assumed: 26 requirements reference the two touched files (EE-*, PD-*, SCH-01, XC-04..06) and all are already RELEASED, the terminal status, and none of them specifies allocation-failure hygiene - so no reqctl set-status was run and no status was moved. ISS-0132.json was already RESOLVED with full resolution/prevention text cross-referencing #428, #406 and #526; verified rather than rewritten. issue_index.json verified consistent: ISS-0132 RESOLVED, ISS-0601-LEAK-001 RESOLVED with supersession note, ISS-0206 OPEN with GH #526, no duplicate ids, next_issue_id 207.
